description: This file defines the WeatherViewModel class, which manages weather-related data and operations for a weather app, including fetching current weather, forecast, managing favorites, and handling search queries.

classes.name: WeatherViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel that handles weather data operations such as fetching current weather, forecast, search, and managing favorite locations.

methods.name: loadCurrentWeather
methods.description: Fetches current weather data for a specified location query.

methods.name: loadForecast
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data for the current location.

methods.name: searchAndLoadWeather
methods.description: Searches for locations matching the query and loads weather data for the first result.

methods.name: refreshCurrentWeather
methods.description: Refreshes current weather and forecast data.

methods.name: addCurrentLocationToFavorites
methods.description: Adds the current weather location to favorites.

methods.name: removeFromFavorites
methods.description: Removes a specified location from favorites.

methods.name: isCurrentLocationInFavorites
methods.description: Checks if the current location is in the favorites list.

methods.name: loadWeatherForFavorite
methods.description: Loads weather data for a specified favorite location.

methods.name: loadFavoriteLocations
methods.description: Loads the list of favorite locations and updates their weather data.
